qualificationRules: repositoryObservation computes technical coverage from canonical committed receipts but does not claim hosted artifact rehash or release approval.
hostedRun requires the exact active GitHub Actions workflow, run, checkout, workspace, runner identity, retained executable, and external artifact rehash.
releaseGate requires hosted evidence and real unexpired definition, campaign, and releaseGate approvals bound to exact hashes.
requirements: All definition documents validate against their declared schemas and cross-references.
Every required tuple selected by aggregate scope has current evidence or remains explicitly incomplete.
Every M2 functional exit gate has its build-bound named production check and every executed performance measurement is derived from a typed receipt rather than a producer supplied numeric assertion.
Every non-waivable invariant selected by scope is evaluated and passed.
Qualification-specific approval and hosted-artifact requirements are satisfied without fabricated identity.
No evidence or attachment violates privacy-safe diagnostics, exact artifact inventory, or safe-path rules.
scopeRules: milestoneClosure derives every required catalog case through the claimed milestone and forbids a caller-selected subset.
caseExecution derives only its explicit case IDs and cannot claim milestone or release closure.

statusRules.blocked: Execution cannot proceed because a selected required resource is unavailable.
statusRules.failed: Any executed selected case, numerical gate, or non-waivable invariant fails.
statusRules.incomplete: Selected evidence is missing, stale, notRun, or qualification-specific requirements are absent.
statusRules.passed: All selected technical requirements pass; this status alone does not imply hosted or release qualification.
